physical_subject: How does a tiny opening make an upside-down image?
relationship: Ideal pinhole projection inverts the image and scales its height by screen distance divided by object distance.
operation: Trace top and bottom rays through a pinhole while the candle and dark chamber remain recognizable; vary screen and object distance.
closest_prior: focal/02-mirror and objects/04-coin: reflected and refracted rays
substantive_difference: A lensless aperture selects straight rays and gives central projection; no focusing mirror or refraction.
